verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a public registry with a REST API, but the evidence only documents per-resource GET requests by unique URI, search tools, and single filing services. Nothing shows a batch endpoint, bulk data product, or multi-item action. Search returning many results and running many individual GETs are adjacent behaviours or user-side workarounds, not a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
